name: MCP-Bench
summary: Accenture's benchmark for tool-using agents on complex real-world tasks across 28 live MCP servers and 250 tools (finance, travel, science, academic search).
description: Tests cross-tool coordination, precise parameter control and planning, end to end over MCP: the repo ships the 28 server implementations, task synthesis and the runner (`run_benchmark.py`), and a Hugging Face Space hosts the leaderboard. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Scaling Environments for Agents (arXiv 2508.20453). The README badge says Apache-2.0, but the repository has no license file.
